mapper.select: SELECT figure_type_id, user_id, figure_type_group_id, name, created_at, updated_at FROM figure_type WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY figure_type_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO figure_type (user_id, figure_type_group_id, name) VALUES (#{userId}, #{figureTypeGroupId}, #{name})
mapper.update: UPDATE figure_type SET name = #{name} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND figure_type_id = #{figureTypeId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM figure_type WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND figure_type_id = #{figureTypeId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.figure_type_id FROM figure_type c JOIN figure_type_group p ON p.figure_type_group_id = c.figure_type_group_id AND p.user_id = c.user_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND p.name = #{defaultName} AND c.name = #{defaultName}
mapper.update: UPDATE figure SET figure_type_id = #{fallbackId} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND figure_type_id = #{figureTypeId}
